usedFor: Teams in construction estimating manage Aginera projects with “Create Project”, “Update Project” and “Delete Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Project” in Aginera
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting opens a project in Aginera, ready to hold the drawings for that job.

watchOut: “Delete Project” removes a chosen project and its documents in Aginera, so check the project before it runs.
